priceNote: Pulled back from S&P 500 inclusion spike ($302 on Jun 22). $2B NVIDIA equity stake + $5B FY27 guide raise = fundamentals intact. KeyBanc PT $385 = 44% upside.
summary: Marvell is the AI infrastructure dark horse — custom silicon (XPUs) for Google, Amazon, Meta plus optical interconnects for every major data center. NVIDIA just took a $2B equity stake and Jensen Huang called MRVL 'the next trillion-dollar company.' The company raised FY27 revenue guidance by $5B to $11.5B and FY28 to $16.5B (+45% YoY). The stock pulled back 11% from its S&P 500 inclusion spike — a clean re-entry window. KeyBanc top target $385 = 44.3% upside from here.
